discount.description: 20% discount applies to base charges only

overage.text: Overage rate: $0.04 per unit above monthly limit of 25,000 units. Charged at end of billing cycle.

base_limit.text: Base usage limit: 25,000 units per month. Measured as individual API transactions across all service tiers.

discount_scope.text: Volume discount of 20% applies exclusively to base subscription charges. All overage and ancillary charges are billed at full rate.
